description: Adversarial cases for the v2 merge gate (D2), built on golden SKUs without changing golden_skus.json or vlm_cassette.json (the v1 baseline pins those). Each case names its base SKU, the candidates it drops, the candidate / SKU fields it overrides and the model readings it overrides ('readings': a VLM misread, written as the model would report it). Labels describe what the image really shows; an overridden label says why. The cases exist so the gate fails when a D4 identity rule, the D10 conflicting-match guard or a query of the D8 plan stops working: the golden set alone cannot show it, because every VLM error there is shadowed by a better-ranked correct candidate and every query surfaces the whole pool. 'rule' names what the case guards. expected_v2: correct_pick | no_pick | not_found | review_unselected | no_auto (any decision but AUTO_PUBLISH) | no_wrong_pick (a pick, if any, is correct_exact).
